# phron_operating_systems (Data Source)

The Operating Systems a new Server can be created from.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "phron_operating_systems" "all" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Always "operating_systems".
- `operating_systems` (Attributes List) The available Operating Systems. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--operating_systems))

<a id="nestedatt--operating_systems"></a>
### Nested Schema for `operating_systems`

Read-Only:

- `display_name` (String) The name for display.
- `id` (String) The id, as phron_server takes it in `operating_system_id`.
- `login_user` (String) The user name to ssh in as.
- `min_disk_gib` (Number) The smallest disk, in GiB, a Server of this Operating System needs.
